Name: Blink Teleport
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]With this mod you can point at any tile on the map, press the key combination (default Ctrl + B), and if the target tile is unobstructed you will be teleported there instantly.[/color]


[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]

By default, blinking takes 10 stamina. If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7831]Mana Bar[/url] is installed, it will use mana instead.

By default, blinking is only allowed outdoors.

By default, blinking will play a sound and show a smoke cloud at the place of origin.

You can use GMCM or edit the config.json file to change these settings.


[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
